purpose: Four rows of ORG1-grouped-raw, end to end, before the registered 4,008-call flight: prove the -np 2 serving geometry on this roster under the LONGER grouped system message, prove that the domain-grouped registry goes on the wire verbatim, prove sealing and the four registered Audio2Tool scorers on real sealed rows, and produce the wall-time projection the flight is launched on. No smoke number is a task measurement.

A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000.selection: deterministic and stated before the rows were read off the roster: (1) the roster's LONGEST sample, which is the flight's worst request -- tier7_multiturn:001033 at 654.635667 s, one of the release's four synthesis defects; then (2) the MEDIAN-length sample of each of the three domains among the remaining rows, ordered by (audio_seconds, sample_id). That covers the worst request, all three domain strata and four of the eight tiers, and the three median rows are what makes the wall-time projection meaningful -- four defect rows would project nothing about 4,000 ordinary ones.

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean pass. The plan registers 12 because attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run id on every request. 12 covers a clean pass plus up to two recoveries; the exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 668.102417 s per pass, 2,004.307251 s across three passes, rounded up to 2,050; the exposure row's ceiling is 2,100. The number is dominated by the single 654.635667 s release-defect row, which is exactly why that row must be proved before the flight.

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape and its system-message hash (which must be the GROUPED variant, sha256 a0b5dd77cceac57d726e43a06b06a4c6699f21ec22973b0ba9ec6e8409879495, 16,490 chars), whether every stratum's audio encodes and returns at all -- most of all the 654-second row -- parse rate, and the per-call latency the flight's wall-time projection is built from
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 4,008-call flight is launched
